senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. קָנַן a. to make straight, firm, right.
to straighten, mend, repair, set in order, prepare.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 308:3">Sifré Deut. 308</cite> <he>אחד … לתַקְּנוֹ</he> one that had a crooked staff, and gave it to a mechanic to straighten it; <he>מְתַקְּנוֹ באור</he> he tries to straighten it by heat; Yalk. ib. 942.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 1:1">Shek. I, 1</cite> <he>מְתַקְּנִין את הדרכים וכ׳</he> they put in repair the roads and the open places (stations) &c.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 28:1">Pesik. R. s. 28</cite> <he>מְתַקְּנִים את המועדות</he> they arrange (fix the dates of) the festivals; <cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 1:4">R. Hash. I, 4</cite>.
<cite ref="Beitzah 34a:11">Bets. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>אין מתקנין את השפוד וכ׳</he> you must not prepare (chip) a spit or sharpen it (on the Holy Day).
<cite ref="Beitzah 34a:10">Ib.</cite> <he>מתקנין את הקונדס וכ׳</he> you may dress artichokes &c.
Gitt. IV, 5 תִּקַּנְתֶּם את רבו וכ׳ you have made it right for his master but not for himself; a. fr.—Trnsf. to make things legally fit for use by giving the priestly dues.

Bets. 34ᵇ עבר ותִקְּנוֹ מְתוּקָּן if he transgressed (the law forbidding the separation of priestly gifts on the Holy Day) and prepared it for use, it is prepared (the act is valid). Y. Dem. II, 23ᶜ bot. כל אחד ואחד מְתַקֵּן דמאי every one of them gives the priestly dues of his purchase as d’mai (v. דְּמַאי).
Tosef. Dem. IV, 5 ודאי שתִּיקְּנָהּ דמאי if one gives the dues of what is sure to be untithed, as if it were d’mai; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to establish, institute, introduce a legal measure, ordain.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 33b:5">Sabb. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>תִּקְּנוּ שווקים וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="U00521"><he>שׁוּק</he> III</cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 33b:5">Ib.</cite> bot. (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 33:18">Gen. XXXIII, 18</cite>) <he>מטבע תי׳ להם</he> he introduced coinage for them.
<cite ref="Megillah 4a:6">Meg. 4ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>משה ת׳ להם … שיהו וכ׳</he> Moses introduced the custom … of discussing and studying the subject of the day &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 14b:5">Sabb. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>שמעון</he> … <he>ת׳ כתובה וכ׳</he> Simon ben Sheṭaḥ introduced the marriage contract (jointure) for the wife.
Succ. V, 2, v. תִּיקּוּן; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. מְתוּקָּן; f. מְתוּקֶּנֶת; pl. מְתוּקָּנִים, מְתוּקָּנִין; מְתוּקָּנוֹת
<cite ref="Beitzah 34b">Bets. 34ᵇ</cite>, v. supra.

<cite ref="Eruvin 32a">Erub. 32ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>חזקה … דבר שאינו מת׳</he> the presumption is in favor of the Ḥaber (<cite ref="H00109"><he>חָבֵר</he></cite>) that he will not let go out of his hands a thing not ritually prepared (tithed &c.).
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 4:8">Tosef. Dem. IV, 8</cite> <he>הטבל והמת׳ שנתערבו</he> if untithed and tithed things have been mixed up.
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 8:13">Ib. VIII, 13</cite> <he>מעשרותיו מת׳ ופירותיו מקולקלין</he> the tithes he separated are right, but his fruits are wrong (considered untithed).
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 6:14">Ib. VI, 14</cite> <he>מת׳</he> scrupulous guardsmen.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 39b">Snh. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>כמת׳ שבהם וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="S01415"><he>קִלְקֵל</he></cite>; a. fr.—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 27:1">Pesik. R. s. 27-28</cite> <he>לצרה הזו הייתי מת׳</he> am I predestined for such trouble? <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 27-28">Ib.</cite> <he>עד … היית מת׳ לדבר</he> (not <he>הייתי</he>) before yet the world was created, thou wast designated for this thing (the prophetic mission). Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 13 <he>שהוא מת׳ מבראשית וכ׳</he> that he (Bezalel) was from the time of creation designated to make the Tabernacle; a. fr.
senses.label: b

units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:12">Ab. II, 12</cite> <he>הַתְקֵן עצמך ללמוד וכ׳</he> fit thyself to study the Law, for it does not come to thee by inheritance.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:16">Ib. IV, 16</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q01659"><he>פְּרוֹזְדוֹר</he></cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Sukkah 51b:11">Succ. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>הִתְקִינוּ שיהו וכ׳</he> they ordained that the women should sit uptairs, and the men below.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 10:3">Shebi. X, 3</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q01646"><he>פְּרוֹזְבּוֹל</he></cite>. Y. R. Hash. IV, 59ᵇ bot. <he>מַתְקִין על דבר תורה</he> introduced a measure extending a Biblical law; <he>מתקין על דבריהן</he> extending a Rabbinical ordinance.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 9:5">Ber. IX, 5</cite> <he>התקינו שיהו וכ׳</he> they ordained that they should say, ‘from everlasting and unto everlasting’; a. fr.
Koh. R. to I, 15 יכול להִתָּקֵן (or להִתַּקֵּן Hithpa.), v. עָוַת.
Ber. 40ᵃ בדבר … בו נִתְקְנוּ (or נִתַּקְּנוּ Nithpa.) they were mended (restored) by the same thing by which they were impaired (sinned); Snh. 70ᵇ; a. e.
